user.title: Nebula
user.description:
Set up the Nebula bridge. This exposes a combined room / scene / automation feed for the Nebula app and panel, advertises this instance on the LAN, and adds connection sensors.

After setup, scan the QR in the **Pair the Nebula app** notification with the Nebula Home app.

pair_code.name: Generate pairing code
pair_code.description: Rotates the Nebula pairing code and re-raises the "Pair the Nebula app" notification with a fresh QR to scan. The code is single-use and valid ~30 minutes. You normally don't need this — the notification appears on its own until an app has paired.

spotify_unlink.name: Unlink Spotify
spotify_unlink.description: Forgets the linked Spotify account (the stored refresh token). Displays and apps will need to sign in again.

init.title: Nebula
init.description:
Panel token (the Nebula panel uses this on /api/nebula/panel, or any valid Home Assistant token):

**{token}**

Tick to generate a new one.

---

**Spotify link** — lets the display and app sign in to Spotify by opening a link or scanning a QR. Create a free app at developer.spotify.com, then add this exact redirect URI to it:

`{redirect_uri}`

Then paste the app's Client ID and Client Secret below. Leave blank to disable.
